subject: Important Updates Regarding Your Account
body: Dear valued customer, We wanted to inform you about some important updates regarding your account. Due to recent security enhancements, we kindly ask you to reset your password to ensure the safety of your personal information. Please click on the link provided in this email to create a new password. If you have any questions or concerns, feel free to contact our customer support team. Thank you for your cooperation. Best regards, The Account Security Team
